hunks.sol: The previous night had been a long one. After an intense back-and-forth, they had finally found common ground that gave each of them what they wanted.

hunks.sol: “Still, we did give you a valuable piece of information, didn’t we?”

hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung replied with a disgruntled look.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, that information? I heard the Datong Branch of our family played some part in it as well.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, that information? I heard our family’s Datong Branch played some part in the matter as well.”

hunks.sol: Wolhwa ran one long finger along her teacup.

hunks.baseline: *It’s highly likely that it was him.*
hunks.sol: *It was most likely him.*

hunks.baseline: Wolhwa narrowed her eyes at his answer, delivered as though he knew nothing.
hunks.sol: Wolhwa narrowed her eyes at his feigned ignorance.

hunks.baseline: But it was difficult for her to question him further. If the Jin Family of Taiyuan had truly been connected to a Supreme Peak master, the family’s rise to its current position would have been far easier.

hunks.baseline: “Well, in any case. My sincere congratulations.”
hunks.sol: “Well, in any case, you have my sincere congratulations.”

hunks.baseline: “But one of you has been silent this whole time.”
hunks.sol: “But someone else has been awfully quiet.”

hunks.baseline: “He’s been dissatisfied since birth.”

hunks.baseline: A prickly voice asked,

hunks.baseline: Wipeng, who had been leaning diagonally against the wall of the office, opened his mouth.

hunks.sol: His subordinate, usually as strict and fussy as an old schoolmaster, was humoring him for once. Jin Wikyung smiled in satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he couldn’t deny that matters involving the Sword Saint and Cheongpung had played a significant role.
hunks.sol: Of course, he couldn’t deny that the Sword Saint and Cheongpung had played a significant role in that.

hunks.baseline: Watching Jin Wikyung grow more cheerful by the moment, Wipeng smiled.
hunks.sol: As Jin Wikyung’s spirits soared, Wipeng smiled.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, the smile at the corners of Wipeng’s mouth vanished without a trace.
hunks.sol: The next moment, the smile vanished from Wipeng’s face without a trace.

hunks.baseline: “At this gathering, where countless martial artists and commoners, distinguished guests from the Nine Sects and One Gang, and even a descendant of the imperial family are coming, both Young Masters are absent.”
hunks.sol: “At this gathering, attended by countless martial artists and commoners, distinguished guests from the Nine Sects and One Gang, and even a member of the imperial family, both Young Masters are absent.”

hunks.sol: “The Third Young Master absolutely cannot be let off the hook. Leaving at a time like this as though none of it concerned him was bad enough, but now all word from him has stopped completely.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung subtly averted his gaze. Wolhwa, his only lifeline, shrugged as if she didn’t know anything either and watched the spectacle.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung quietly averted his gaze. Wolhwa, his only lifeline, merely shrugged as if she knew nothing and watched the spectacle unfold.

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, he’ll come? He left last year saying he’d be back shortly.”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean, he’ll come? He left last year saying he’d be right back.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was about to object, then paused. When he thought about it, Wipeng’s words sounded strange, but they weren’t wrong.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung opened his mouth to object, then stopped. The way Wipeng phrased it sounded strange, but it wasn’t wrong.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng ground his teeth and continued.
hunks.sol: Wipeng ground his teeth.

hunks.baseline: “Going off to make a weapon when we’re facing such a momentous occasion… I’m an idiot for trusting the Third Young Master even for a moment.”
hunks.sol: “Running off to have a weapon made with such a momentous occasion looming… I’m the idiot for trusting the Third Young Master even for a moment.”

hunks.baseline: Wipeng’s lips moved as if he wanted to say something, but he let out a deep sigh instead. It wasn’t as though this had only happened once or twice. They had to deal with what was right in front of them first.
hunks.sol: Wipeng’s lips moved as though he still had more to say, but he released a deep sigh instead. This was hardly the first time something like this had happened. They had to deal with the business at hand first.

hunks.baseline: Fifty martial artists radiating sharp auras stood in formation before the pavilion. Every one of them was at least a First Rate master, and they stared at their lord with unwavering composure.
hunks.sol: Fifty martial artists radiating sharp auras stood in formation before the pavilion. Every one of them was at least a First Rate master, and they watched their lord with unwavering focus.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was a giant standing eight cheok tall. As the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, he had led the family in place of the absent Family Head for the past two years and had finally set it on a firm foundation.
hunks.sol: An eight-cheok-tall giant, Jin Wikyung was the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. In place of the absent Family Head, he had led the family for the past two years and finally set it upon a firm foundation.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng, Wolhwa, and the fifty martial artists followed behind him. And each time they crossed another part of the quiet Jin Family of Taiyuan’s grounds, their numbers grew.
hunks.sol: Wipeng, Wolhwa, and the fifty martial artists followed him. As they crossed the quiet grounds of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, their numbers continued to swell.

hunks.baseline: The Jin Family of Taiyuan had suffered the pain of losing limbs during the previous war, but its recovery had been swift, and its growth had been steep.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family of Taiyuan had suffered as though its limbs had been torn away in the previous war, but its recovery had been swift, and its growth even swifter.

hunks.baseline: They were the arms and legs, the waist and torso of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, which had grown stronger and sturdier.
hunks.sol: They were the arms, legs, waist, and torso of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, stronger and sturdier than ever before.

hunks.baseline: Remembering the countless sacrifices and efforts that had been required to reach this day, Jin Wikyung felt his chest tighten with emotion.
hunks.sol: Remembering the countless sacrifices and efforts that had brought them to this day, Jin Wikyung felt a surge of emotion.

hunks.baseline: The gate guards standing watch at the main entrance bowed with crisp, disciplined movements. Beyond the flawlessly built stone walls, the cheers of countless people could be heard.
hunks.sol: The gate guards standing watch at the main entrance bowed with crisp, disciplined movements. Beyond the solid stone walls, the cheers of countless people rang out.

hunks.baseline: Wolhwa was smiling brightly, while Wipeng wore a more solemn expression than ever.
hunks.sol: Wolhwa smiled brightly, while Wipeng wore a more solemn expression than ever.

hunks.baseline: It was the beginning of the grand banquet that would continue for the next three days—and the opening salvo announcing that the Jin Family of Taiyuan had become the hegemon of Shanxi Murim.
hunks.sol: It marked the beginning of the grand banquet that would continue for the next three days—and served as the signal flare announcing that the Jin Family of Taiyuan had become the hegemon of Shanxi Murim.

hunks.baseline: Even though it was broad daylight, firecrackers celebrating the first day of the new year went off now and then.
hunks.sol: Even in broad daylight, firecrackers celebrating the first day of the new year occasionally burst overhead.

hunks.baseline: While well over several hundred people laughed and chatted in the festive atmosphere, some wore faces like they were attending a funeral.
hunks.sol: While hundreds upon hundreds of people laughed and chatted in the festive atmosphere, a handful wore faces fit for a funeral.

hunks.baseline: “What kind of situation is this?”
hunks.sol: “How did it come to this?”

hunks.baseline: “I ought to just—”
hunks.sol: “Those little bastards…”

hunks.sol: The five middle-aged men—the heads of the five sects collectively known as the Five Gates of Shanxi—couldn’t smooth out their crumpled expressions.

hunks.sol: He had arrived five days earlier and requested a meeting countless times.

hunks.sol: But the carefully prepared letters and gifts he sent had been turned away without ever crossing the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s threshold. His pride had taken a beating, but in the end, he had resorted to coming in person.

hunks.sol: “I am Woo, the man who heads the Seongun Escort Bureau.”

hunks.sol: But to be treated this way by a mere gate guard!
